Here's a LinkedIn post for you:

---

I'm thrilled to announce that I've officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**! 🎉

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, this feels like a natural next step in a journey I'm deeply passionate about. I'm excited to contribute to the committee and help move the standard forward as it continues to play a critical role in clinical decision support and healthcare interoperability.

If you or your organization are **already using CDS Hooks**, I'd love to see your implementation represented in the community! Please consider adding it to the CDS Hooks Availability page:
👉 https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

And if you **haven't adopted CDS Hooks yet** but are exploring how it could enhance your clinical workflows, I'm available as a **freelance consultant** to help you with implementation. Feel free to reach out — I'd love to chat!

Here's to building smarter, more connected healthcare systems together. 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #FHIR #HealthcareInteroperability #FreelanceConsultant #HL7

---

Feel free to adjust the tone or details to your liking!
